name: NordPass
summary: NordPass offers Teams, Business and Enterprise plans from $1.99 to $5.99 per user a month on a one-year term, with monthly billing available at a higher price. Single sign-on with Entra ID or Okta and SCIM provisioning come only with Enterprise.

facts.text: NordPass encrypts vault items with XChaCha20 under a zero-knowledge design and can store passkeys.
NordPass signs a HIPAA business associate agreement with eligible customers on an annual Business or Enterprise plan.
Cure53 audited NordPass Business in 2021 and found 15 issues, one rated high, which NordPass fixed and Cure53 then verified.
The NordPass Trust Center offers its SOC 2 Type 2 report, ISO 27001 certificate and penetration test report on request.
Teams and Business plans support single sign-on with Google Workspace only.

plans.name: Teams
plans.unit: per user, sold in packs of 10

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: One-year term. $5.99 on monthly billing. Minimum 5 users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: One-year term. $7.99 on monthly billing. Minimum 5 users.

hiddenCosts: Single sign-on with Entra ID, ADFS or Okta and SCIM provisioning are on the Enterprise plan only.
Teams is sold only in packs of 10 users, and Business and Enterprise need at least 5 users.
Monthly billing costs 25% to 50% more than the one-year price.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period without a refund for unused time; a refund can be requested within 14 days of the first purchase.
contract.dataExport: A plain CSV file from the desktop app or web vault; admins can limit exporting by policy.
